Name: Executor
Description: The Executor is a New York City firefighter. While on duty, he witnessed a possessed Wrecker killing a number of civilians. While Wrecker was eventually stopped by Doctor Strange, the firefighter was already traumatized. When therapy didn't help, he turned to magic. He started acquiring spellbooks and studied them voraciously, until he was able to command the dead.
